# GitHub & review

Open and watch pull requests, review a workspace before landing, and run project automations from GitHub events.

Pack id `github`. Back to [all packs](README.md).

## Plugins

1. [`@dshfiles/pull-requests`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/pull-requests/README.md) — Link GitHub pull requests to DSH threads, watch status transitions, and settle terminal threads.
2. [`@dshfiles/diffs-review`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/diffs-review/README.md) — Review this thread's changes in one scrollable diff, grouped by review scope and marked as you read.
3. [`@dshfiles/project-automations`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/project-automations/README.md) — Per-project automations: cron, daily, weekly or fixed-rate schedules and HMAC-signed webhooks that each start a new thread in a project with a templated prompt, agent preset and model, with a run history.

## Prerequisites

1. The project is a jj or git repository.
2. The GitHub CLI is signed in (`gh auth login`).

## Key settings

1. **Refresh pull requests when a thread changes**: Settings entry `dshfiles-pull-requests`, field `refreshOnThreadEvents`.

## Enable it

1. In the app: **Knowledge › Getting started**, then **Enable pack** on GitHub & review under Packs. It previews exactly what changes; **Disable pack** reverses it.
2. From an Agent: the `onboarding_pack_apply` tool with pack `github`. It runs only when you ask, after showing the preview.
3. From a shell: `dshx init --profile <name> --packs github` (Core is added; `--dry-run` previews). See [`dshx init`](../../tooling/dshx/docs/cli-reference.md#dshx-init-compose-a-profile-from-packs).

## Restart

Installing a plugin the profile does not have yet needs a DSH Host restart: DSH reads the profile once at boot. Plugins already installed are switched on in the running DSH. Nothing restarts on its own: use **Restart when idle** in the sidebar when DSH runs under the managed launcher, otherwise your own launcher.
